about.title: Service first, quality always.
text: MD Fence Co is a family-operated, fully insured residential and commercial fencing contractor, and we have been installing fences in the Houston area since 2018.

Our dedicated crews have over 20 years of combined experience in the fence industry and advanced carpentry. We consistently rank among the top Houston fence contractors for our customer service, and we are proud to be Houston's trusted fence contractor for the Texas Department of Transportation.

Whether you want a custom-designed fence to increase the value of your property or to replace an outdated one, contact us to speak with one of our fence consultants, who will guide you through the process.
about.imageAlt: A new wood privacy fence along a side yard path

faqs.q: How long have you been installing fences in Houston?
faqs.a: We have been installing fences in the Houston area since 2018. Since then we have established ourselves as one of the most reliable, most trusted fencing contractors in the area.

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured to install fences in Houston?
faqs.a: We meet all licensing and insurance requirements for each municipality where we install fences. Each municipality has different requirements for contractors, so speak with us directly about the requirements for your town. We are happy to provide proof of insurance and licensure information.

Yes. We use professional-grade materials from high-quality manufacturers, so in most cases you are protected by the manufacturer warranty on the materials, and we offer a workmanship warranty on all residential and commercial fences we install. Talk to our fence experts for the full details on your specific project.

faqs.q: How much does a new fence cost?
faqs.a: Prices depend on the type of fence, how much fencing you need, and the style, height and options you choose. We provide fencing quotes for free, so reach out through our online form or give us a call and we will plan a consultation.

faqs.q: How long will it take to get my fence installed?
faqs.a: Generally it takes a few days at most for one of our fence experts to reach your property, walk it and give you a detailed estimate. Once you approve the estimate we can often install within one to three weeks, though specially ordered materials, styles, colors or add-ons can delay a start. Check with our office about your specific project.

faqs.q: What is the most popular type of fence in Houston?
faqs.a: Chain link, wrought iron and wood fences are all very popular here. The most popular styles are the 3-rail black wrought iron fence, used for perimeter fencing, pools and decorative work, and the standard 6 ft. wood privacy fence.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to get a fence installed?
faqs.a: Every local municipality has its own requirements, and the height, placement or purpose of the fence can change whether a permit is needed. There are HOA considerations in some areas too. The best way to get a specific answer is to call your town building code office, and we are happy to guide you through the process.

faqs.q: Do I need a survey done before installing a fence?
faqs.a: Fence placement is ultimately the customer's responsibility, and moving a fence after installation can be costly, so a survey is never a bad idea. In many cases property lines are clear and well marked and no official survey is needed, but some municipalities do require one.

faqs.q: What time of year is best to install a fence in Houston?
faqs.a: There is no bad time of year. We build fences across the Houston area all year. Some times are busier than others, so reach out to find out what the current schedule looks like.

faqs.q: Do you have fence materials on site to purchase?
faqs.a: Yes. We have many fence materials and styles available for purchase on-site at our company office and yard in Houston, from nails, wood and concrete to some of the tools for the job. Whether you are a contractor or a property owner, our team can help.
